title: Prefix-cache hit rate
description: Cached prompt tokens divided by queried prompt tokens across inference engines. A low rate with high prompt throughput suggests repeated prefill work. The fraction weights cache reuse by prompt tokens, and sampling patterns affect it; requires engine telemetry. Run-wide: this panel ignores the Job and Execution pickers.

defaults.noValue: No vLLM rows for this run. If the whole rank is blank, the engine exporter is down rather than six separate faults.
